page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g6 server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a baseline clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 24 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 96.0 GB of system memory, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. The balanced ratio of compute resources to memory makes it a standard choice for workloads that require consistent CPU performance without specialized acceleration.

The hardware profile is suited for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application servers, enterprise databases, and medium-scale development or build environments. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute performance remains stable and predictable under continuous operational loads.
